scope: Unpublished shared organizational group authoring in one ordinary registered recipe document. No author-schema/backend-protocol change, release, commit, installation or device acceptance.
behavior: ADD one shared group with one caller-allocated fresh group UUID per related placement, stable across form changes and rechecks.
EDIT the raw display name and parent while retaining group key and generated identities; forbid cycles and hierarchy beyond sixteen levels.
ASSIGN one existing shared actor to a group or remove its group declaration; effective runtime fields, coordinates and actor order remain.
REMOVE only an empty leaf with no direct actor or child, removing every related group map; permit the last empty group and retain empty containers.
All four actions work for unused fragments with no generated targets. CST patches retain unrelated source bytes, BOM/CRLF, offsets and overrides.
Independent optional groups ABI and pure proposal/apply contracts; the new UI cannot grant sibling editors or execution backends authority.
Complete candidates bind source, stable identities, names, parent declaration presence and ordered memberships before memory application. Ordinary Save alone persists and guards external conflicts.

runtime.scope: Actual desktop preparation verified catalog archive and pinned Node before native helper compilation.

faultInjections: One out-of-catalog parent option is deliberately added to the DOM select to test refusal of an invalid raw parent intent.
Only the three real HTTP candidate deliveries named name/parent/member are modified after untouched responses are captured.
A real preview response is held while its child is forcibly closed, parent preview closed and an actual visible source edit advances ownership.
Capability phases wrap only the new groups WASM capability export at boot; all other exports/controllers/HTTP remain real.
flowAssertions: ADD supplies one fresh group UUID for each source-ordered placement, keeps identities through invalid-name correction, and reviews complete group/membership provenance; Cancel preserves every author file.

ADD preserves allocation across key/name input, checks and three 390px languages. Silent unreviewed text cannot apply; guarded Apply updates memory only and ordinary Save/reopen retains exact BOM/CRLF and both stable group mappings.
EDIT changes the shared raw name and parent across every placement while retaining all group/actor UUIDs, source order, geometry, projections, images, local overrides and offset lexemes.

ASSIGN moves the shared actor into the new mapped group and then to the root by removing groupKey. Nonempty or parent groups cannot be removed; once empty, leaf REMOVE deletes the declaration and every placement map without implicit promotion or identity/geometry changes.

A cyclic reparent, a deliberately injected unknown parent option and a seventeenth-level group are rejected atomically. Authored labels/parent values and allocated IDs stay available for correction; the separate sixteen-level source fixture is byte-identical.

Unused fragments use source declarations to guard occupied groups, support all four actions with empty generated target lists, and may remove their last empty group while retaining groups:[]; their changes do not invent effective instances.

Real valid HTTP candidates with unchanged identities but deliberately forged group name, parent or actor membership cannot approve. Each bad temporary receipt is released and the untouched raw intent can be rechecked successfully.
A held real candidate arriving after the child/parent close and an actual visible source edit never replaces the new draft, reopens its view or grants stale approval; its host preview is released.

When only the new groups ABI is absent or unsupported, its entry closes independently and all seven previous recipe editors still open/cancel through real current helpers without author or backend build writes.

Ordinary Save detects an external recipe write and retains both reviewed local draft and disk bytes. Original OC, projections, images, metadata and deep-depth fixture remain unchanged; organizational editing never starts a backend build.

prepared.scope: Actual desktop/mobile prepared copies in standard VM without Node/DOM/fetch/process; this is portability, not a hostile-code sandbox or installed/device acceptance.

New group helper still being authored had a closing-parenthesis syntax error; corrected before frozen/final runs.
58 passed and one NEW assertion incorrectly compared changing source provenance ranges/revisions; retain all effective actor fields, independently verify full provenance; final 59 pass.
Helper syntax and NEW host fixture import failed during initial authoring; only new helper/fixture corrected, final 41 pass and 322 regression pass.
Eight workflows passed, then NEW smoke used the wrong old override button ID; fixture corrected and both full ten-flow actual browser reruns passed.

limits: Only organizational declaration and mapping tokens are changed; existing 128 KiB/128 actor-group-placement and depth16 budgets
No implicit deletion promotion, reorder, spatial transform, fragment-definition editor, nested/cross-file reuse, multi-file transaction or cross-view history
No executable recipe build, backend/runtime protocol update or installed desktop/mobile acceptance
